description: 24.11, the lantern festival evening. Haze builds up over the festival grounds, and at 11:00 a news site reports that the mass lantern release is cancelled because of air quality. Expect an air quality notice, an urgent news push the same morning, and a red day.

events.note: Haze forecast over the festival: PM2.5 130
